create_locate3d_dataset: create a Locate3DDataset instance with annotation paths and data directory paths
load_encoder_3djepa: load a pretrained 3D JEPA encoder model using Encoder3DJEPA.from_pretrained
downsample_pointcloud: downsample a featurized sensor pointcloud to a target number of points
index_dataset_scene: access a specific scene from the Locate3DDataset by integer index
run_3djepa_inference: run the 3D JEPA encoder model on a featurized pointcloud to get output embeddings
